name: @leetcamp/domain
//exports: Conditional exports, and the `development` condition is the load-bearing one.
tsx and vitest apply it, so they resolve straight to ./src/index.ts and the
specs run without a prior build. Plain `node` does NOT apply it: it falls to
`default` and needs ./dist/index.js, which is why the API Dockerfile compiles
every workspace and copies each dist/ into the runtime image.
Drop `development` and every test run needs a build first.
//scripts: The four names are fixed: health.sh step 2 fails the whole run if a workspace
does not declare typecheck/build/test/lint (or carry a documented exemption),
because `pnpm -r <script>` skips a missing script in complete silence.
`lint` does `cd ../..` first: eslint-plugin-boundaries resolves file paths
relative to the repo root, and running it from inside the package makes every
path stop matching the element patterns — the rules then pass vacuously.
//devDependencies: Versions are conservative ^ ranges. Resolve the real ones with Context7 MCP before installing — see the README.
